one_liner: A wallet-card-sized Bluetooth tracker that rings your phone (and that your phone can ring), powered by a sealed thin primary cell for about two years.

target_retail_price.label: estimate
target_retail_price.source_or_assumption: Founder target retail price $24.99 (comparable wallet trackers retail in the $20-35 range, not verified)

key_features: Bluetooth Low Energy 5: ring the card from the phone, ring the phone from the card
Sealed thin lithium primary cell, no charging
constraints: Must slide into a wallet card slot
Lithium cell: UN38.3 transport test summary required

BLE ring only, or also UWB precision finding?
